items.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the legislative law, in relation to authorizing the joint
commission on public integrity to provide a training course concerning
anti-sexual harassment training for lobbyists and requiring lobbyists to
complete the course annually
items.lawCode: Amd §1-d, ren §§1-u & 1-v to be §§1-x & 1-y, add §1-u, Leg L
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S1059

SPONSOR: LIU
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the legislative law, in relation to authorizing the
joint commission on public integrity to provide a training course
concerning anti-sexual harassment training for lobbyists and requiring
lobbyists to complete the course annually

 
PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

To require anti-sexual harassment training for lobbyists appearing
before members of the legislature.

 
SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:

Section 1:  Directs the Joint Commission on Public Ethics to develop an
anti-sexual harassment training curriculum required for registered
lobbyists. Requires JCOPE to report on which lobbyists have completed
the training.

Section 2:  Requires registered lobbyists to complete the anti-sexual
harassment training course.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

The Department of Labor has long recognized the need for anti-harassment
training to help prevent hostile work environments.  Annual training to
prevent sexual harassment is mandated for all legislators and legisla-
tive staff.

Lobbyists frequently work in close proximity to legislators, legislative
staff and government officials, and they must register with the state in
order to conduct business before the New York State government. As a
condition of their registration, lobbyists should undergo annual anti-
sexual harassment training, similar to that required of the Legislature,
to ensure they uphold the standards expected in NYS government. This
simple requirement for lobbyists will help protect legislators, legisla-
tive employees and lobbyists alike from harassment and misconduct.

 
PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY: NEW BILL

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

TBD

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
The act shall take effect immediately and shall apply to individuals
registered as lobbyists on and after January 1, 2021.

BILL NUMBER: S1059A

SPONSOR: LIU
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the legislative law, in relation to authorizing the
joint commission on public integrity to provide a training course
concerning anti-sexual harassment training for lobbyists and requiring
lobbyists to complete the course annually

To require anti-sexual harassment training for lobbyists appearing
before members of the legislature.

 
SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:

Section 1: Directs the Joint Commission on Public Ethics (JCOPE) to
develop an anti-sexual harassment training curriculum required for
registered lobbyists. The curriculum shall include materials specific to
the lobbying and advocacy industry. Lobbyists who have not completed the
training by the required date will be prohibited from engaging in lobby-
ing activities.

Section 2: Requires registered lobbyists to complete the anti-sexual
harassment training course annually.

Section 3: Provides the effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

The Department of Labor has long recognized the need for anti-harassment
training to help prevent hostile work environments.  Annual training to
prevent sexual harassment is mandated for all legislators and legisla-
tive staff.

Lobbyists frequently work in close proximity to legislators, legislative
staff and government officials, and they must register with the state in
order to conduct business before the New York State government. As a
condition of their registration, lobbyists should undergo annual anti-
sexual harassment training, similar to that required of the Legislature,
to ensure they uphold the standards expected in NYS government. This
simple requirement for lobbyists will help protect legislators, legisla-
tive employees and lobbyists alike from harassment and misconduct.

 
PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

NEW BILL

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

TBD

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
The act shall take effect immediately and shall apply to individuals
registered as lobbyists on and after January 1, 2021.
